data.title: 平冢静 · 温泉旅馆水汽的成熟娇颜
data.description: 箱根温泉旅馆幽静的私人露天石池，热气在微凉的晚风中冉冉升腾。平冢静倚在池边的古朴岩石上，清澈的温泉水波漫至胸口。被水汽打湿的黑发柔顺贴在她成熟优美的后颈与脊背上，池水映出月光。她端起浮水木盘里的清酒杯轻抿一口，侧眸望向身旁，眼神中尽是看透世事的豁达与独对心上人的温存柔情。
data.location: secluded traditional ryokan cedarwood hot spring bath
data.action: soaking in outdoor hot spring leaning against smooth stone, wet black hair swept over bare shoulder, holding small sake cup from floating tray, flushed mature face, loving gentle gaze
data.lighting: soft stone lantern glow reflecting on ripples under moonlit night sky
data.mood: refined mature sensuality, serene unhurried romantic escape
data.promptProse: Soaking in a private outdoor hot spring beneath a starry night sky, Shizuka Hiratsuka rests against a smooth rock holding a sake cup. Steam rises around her bare shoulders and wet black hair as she smiles with serene maturity.
data.animaCaption: Shizuka relaxing in an outdoor hot spring with a cup of sake, smiling with mature warmth.
